name: cf-cms
description: CF CMS: a multilingual blog and CMS on the Cloudflare free tier (Pages, D1, R2, Workers AI), with MCP and prefab themes.

scripts.db:seed: node scripts/render-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute cf-blogger-db --local --file=seed/seed.sql
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-release.mjs && node --test scripts/setup-lib.test.mjs scripts/footer-credit.test.mjs scripts/content-ops.test.mjs scripts/schedule.test.mjs scripts/site-copy.test.mjs scripts/mcp-stdio.test.mjs
scripts.test: node --test scripts/setup-lib.test.mjs scripts/footer-credit.test.mjs scripts/content-ops.test.mjs scripts/schedule.test.mjs scripts/site-copy.test.mjs scripts/mcp-stdio.test.mjs
